verified.exploit_entry_point: Public library API only: Browsershot::url(<address>). The hidden tests point the library's node executable at a recording renderer double; no browser, network or download is used.
sites: src/Browsershot.php:258-264 (setUrl refuses only a bare file:// or file:/ prefix, with no whitespace or source-view handling)
routes: A1: a local-file address written with leading whitespace, in source-view form, or with backslashes passes the page-address guard and becomes the navigation address
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own URL-guard assertions are reproduced unchanged in the functional group (4 cases). Locally the control suites were run on the pinned tree (4 security fail, 11 functional pass), the published fix state (4/11 pass), the first published fix (2 security fail), the miss and over-broad patches, the alternative fix and the hardening fix.

traps.reason_to_dismiss: a guard is present and the documented example forms are refused, so the setter reads as already protected
traps.realistic_because: the two published advisory routes at the pinned commit
